Private Function GV(ByVal o As Object, ByVal n As String) As String
    Dim v As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    v = CallByName(o, n, VbGet)
    If IsArray(v) Then
        GV = "arr"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        GV = "Null"
    Else
        GV = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
    Exit Function
Failed:
    GV = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function GO(ByVal o As Object, ByVal n As String) As String
    Dim x As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set x = CallByName(o, n, VbGet)
    If x Is Nothing Then GO = "Nothing" Else GO = "obj:" & TypeName(x)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    GO = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function G(ByVal o As Object, ByVal n As String) As String
    G = GV(o, n)
    If G = "E450" Or G = "E438" Or G = "E13" Or G = "E91" Then G = G & "/" & GO(o, n)
End Function

Private Function Made(ByVal wb As Workbook) As Object
    Dim ws As Worksheet, pt As Object
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:D5").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array("k", "p", "v", "q"), Array("a", "x", 1, "m"), Array("b", "y", 2, "n"), Array("a", "y", 3, "m"), Array("c", "x", 4, "n"))))
    Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:D5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("I3"), "PT")
    pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.PivotFields("p").Orientation = xlPageField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum
    Set Made = pt
End Function

Public Function Reads() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, pt As Object, s As String, n As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set pt = Made(wb)
    For Each n In Array("MissingItemsLimit", "OptimizeCache", "RefreshPeriod", "BackgroundQuery", "CommandText", "CommandType", "Connection", "IsConnected", "LocalConnection", "MaintainConnection", "QueryType", "RobustConnect", "SavePassword", "SourceConnectionFile", "SourceDataFile", "UpgradeOnRefresh", "UseLocalConnection", "WorkbookConnection", "ADOConnection", "Recordset")
        s = s & "~" & G(pt.PivotCache, CStr(n))
    Next
    For Each n In Array("SmallGrid", "PageFieldStyle", "VacatedStyle", "PrintDrillIndicators", "ShowPageMultipleItemLabel", "DisplayMemberPropertyTooltips", "EnableWriteback", "AllocationMethod", "AllocationValue", "Allocation", "AllocationWeightExpression", "TotalsAnnotation", "ViewCalculatedMembers", "VisualTotals", "VisualTotalsForSets", "CalculatedMembersInFilters", "Hidden", "MDX", "ChangeList", "CubeFields", "CalculatedMembers", "PivotChart", "SelectionMode", "PivotSelection", "PivotSelectionStandard", "InnerDetail", "AutoRefresh")
        s = s & "~" & G(pt, CStr(n))
    Next
    For Each n In Array("AutoShowCount", "AutoShowField", "AutoShowRange", "AutoShowType", "CurrentPageList", "CurrentPageName", "DatabaseSort", "DisplayAsCaption", "DisplayAsTooltip", "DisplayInReport", "DragToColumn", "DragToData", "DragToHide", "DragToPage", "DragToRow", "DrilledDown", "EnableItemSelection", "Hidden", "HiddenItemsList", "IncludeNewItemsInFilter", "IsMemberProperty", "PropertyOrder", "ServerBased", "ShowAllItems", "SourceCaption", "UseMemberPropertyAsCaption", "VisibleItemsList", "CubeField", "PropertyParentField", "MemberPropertyCaption")
        s = s & "~" & G(pt.PivotFields("k"), CStr(n))
    Next
    For Each n In Array("CurrentPageName", "ShowAllItems", "DragToRow", "EnableItemSelection", "DatabaseSort", "ServerBased")
        s = s & "~" & G(pt.PivotFields("p"), CStr(n))
    Next
    For Each n In Array("DragToRow", "ShowAllItems", "EnableItemSelection", "DatabaseSort", "ServerBased")
        s = s & "~" & G(pt.PivotFields("q"), CStr(n))
    Next
    For Each n In Array("DragToRow", "ShowAllItems", "EnableItemSelection", "DatabaseSort", "ServerBased", "AutoShowCount")
        s = s & "~" & G(pt.DataFields(1), CStr(n))
    Next
    For Each n In Array("DrilledDown", "ParentShowDetail", "RecordCount", "SourceNameStandard")
        s = s & "~" & G(pt.PivotFields("k").PivotItems(1), CStr(n))
    Next
    For Each n In Array("RecordCount", "SourceNameStandard")
        s = s & "~" & G(pt.PivotFields("k").PivotItems("b"), CStr(n))
    Next
    wb.Close False
    Reads = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, pt As Object, pc As Object, pf As Object, pp As Object, pq As Object, pd As Object
    Dim v As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set pt = Made(wb)
    Set pc = pt.PivotCache
    Set pf = pt.PivotFields("k")
    Set pp = pt.PivotFields("p")
    Set pq = pt.PivotFields("q")
    Set pd = pt.DataFields(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        pt.SmallGrid = True
        v = pt.SmallGrid
    Case 1
        pt.PrintDrillIndicators = True
        v = pt.PrintDrillIndicators
    Case 2
        pt.ShowPageMultipleItemLabel = False
        v = pt.ShowPageMultipleItemLabel
    Case 3
        pt.DisplayMemberPropertyTooltips = False
        v = pt.DisplayMemberPropertyTooltips
    Case 4
        pt.TotalsAnnotation = True
        v = pt.TotalsAnnotation
    Case 5
        pt.VisualTotals = False
        v = pt.VisualTotals
    Case 6
        pt.VisualTotalsForSets = True
        v = pt.VisualTotalsForSets
    Case 7
        pt.CalculatedMembersInFilters = True
        v = pt.CalculatedMembersInFilters
    Case 8
        pt.PageFieldStyle = "PivotStyleDark1"
        v = pt.PageFieldStyle
    Case 9
        pt.VacatedStyle = "Good"
        v = pt.VacatedStyle
    Case 10
        pt.EnableWriteback = True
        v = pt.EnableWriteback
    Case 11
        pt.AutoRefresh = True
        v = pt.AutoRefresh
    Case 12
        pt.Hidden = True
        v = pt.Hidden
    Case 13
        pc.MissingItemsLimit = xlMissingItemsNone
        v = pc.MissingItemsLimit
    Case 14
        pc.OptimizeCache = True
        v = pc.OptimizeCache
    Case 15
        pc.BackgroundQuery = True
        v = pc.BackgroundQuery
    Case 16
        pc.SavePassword = True
        v = pc.SavePassword
    Case 17
        pc.UpgradeOnRefresh = True
        v = pc.UpgradeOnRefresh
    Case 18
        pc.RefreshPeriod = 5
        v = pc.RefreshPeriod
    Case 19
        pf.DragToColumn = False
        v = pf.DragToColumn
    Case 20
        pf.DragToRow = False
        v = pf.DragToRow
    Case 21
        pf.DragToPage = False
        v = pf.DragToPage
    Case 22
        pf.DragToData = False
        v = pf.DragToData
    Case 23
        pf.DragToHide = False
        v = pf.DragToHide
    Case 24
        pf.ShowAllItems = False
        v = pf.ShowAllItems
    Case 25
        pf.IncludeNewItemsInFilter = True
        v = pf.IncludeNewItemsInFilter
    Case 26
        pf.EnableItemSelection = False
        v = pf.EnableItemSelection
    Case 27
        pf.DatabaseSort = True
        v = pf.DatabaseSort
    Case 28
        pf.AutoShowCount = 3
        v = pf.AutoShowCount
    Case 29
        pf.ServerBased = True
        v = pf.ServerBased
    Case 30
        pf.SourceCaption = "zz"
        v = pf.SourceCaption
    Case 31
        pt.SmallGrid = True
        pt.SmallGrid = False
        v = pt.SmallGrid
    Case 32
        pt.PrintDrillIndicators = True
        pt.PrintDrillIndicators = False
        v = pt.PrintDrillIndicators
    Case 33
        pt.ShowPageMultipleItemLabel = False
        pt.ShowPageMultipleItemLabel = True
        v = pt.ShowPageMultipleItemLabel
    Case 34
        pt.PageFieldStyle = "PivotStyleDark1"
        pt.PageFieldStyle = ""
        v = pt.PageFieldStyle
    Case 35
        pt.VacatedStyle = "Good"
        pt.VacatedStyle = ""
        v = pt.VacatedStyle
    Case 36
        pc.MissingItemsLimit = xlMissingItemsNone
        pc.MissingItemsLimit = xlMissingItemsDefault
        v = pc.MissingItemsLimit
    Case 37
        pc.MissingItemsLimit = xlMissingItemsMax2
        v = pc.MissingItemsLimit
    Case 38
        pc.MissingItemsLimit = 5
        v = pc.MissingItemsLimit
    Case 39
        pc.MissingItemsLimit = -2
        v = pc.MissingItemsLimit
    Case 40
        pf.DragToColumn = False
        pf.DragToColumn = True
        v = pf.DragToColumn
    Case 41
        pf.DragToHide = False
        pf.DragToHide = True
        v = pf.DragToHide
    Case 42
        pf.IncludeNewItemsInFilter = True
        pf.IncludeNewItemsInFilter = False
        v = pf.IncludeNewItemsInFilter
    Case 43
        pf.EnableItemSelection = False
        pf.EnableItemSelection = True
        v = pf.EnableItemSelection
    Case 44
        pt.PageFieldStyle = "nonsense"
        v = pt.PageFieldStyle
    Case 45
        pt.SmallGrid = "x"
        v = pt.SmallGrid
    Case 46
        pf.DragToRow = Null
        v = pf.DragToRow
    Case 47
        pq.DragToColumn = False
        v = pq.DragToColumn
    Case 48
        pd.DragToColumn = False
        v = pd.DragToColumn
    Case 49
        pp.ShowAllItems = True
        v = pp.ShowAllItems
    Case 50
        pp.DragToRow = False
        v = pp.DragToRow
    Case 51
        pq.ShowAllItems = True
        v = pq.ShowAllItems
    Case 52
        v = "plain"
    End Select
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Tried = "ok " & CStr(v)
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    s = Reads()
    For i = 0 To 52
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = s
End Function
